purpose: Teach: 相模原/小嶋/佐原/文京/原画/沢田/クイック/壇上

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが神奈川県相模原のJAXAニュースを観てらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father is watching news about JAXA down in Sagamihara, Kanagawa.
lines.style: Warm, informative tone. Light touch of amusement at relaying dad's interests. Unhurried, like she's sharing a small domestic observation with genuine affection.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと小嶋家との交流の写真見たよ
lines.en: Mom, I saw photos of Dad with the Kojima family — they were hanging out together.
lines.style: Bright, eager voice. A slight lift at the discovery. Quick pace, like he can't wait to share. Genuine pleasure, not performing for approval.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが千葉県佐原のお祭りの旅程を考えてらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father is planning a trip to the festival in Sawara, Chiba.
lines.style: Gentle, observational tone. Slight pause before 'is planning'—she's picturing it. Calm, almost thoughtful delivery, like she's part of the plan too.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと東京の文京区のシビックセンター行ったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I went to the Civic Center in Bunkyo Ward, Tokyo—it was really cool.
lines.style: Warm excitement. A small, genuine laugh underneath. Natural pace. He's not rushing to impress, just sharing something that mattered.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがジブリ作品の原画展に行かれるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your father is going to see the original artwork exhibition for Studio Ghibli films.
lines.style: Knowing warmth. A touch of indulgence—she knows this will matter to Sho. Measured pace. Slight emphasis on 'original artwork' like she's delivering good news.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと沢田研二の懐メロカラオケしたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I did karaoke together—we sang old classics by Sawada Kenji.
lines.style: Unbridled brightness. Small voice, big joy. Quick, unpracticed rhythm—just natural childhood excitement. A little breathless on the memory.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがクイックタイプの電子レンジを新調されたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father just bought a new quick-heat microwave.
lines.style: Calm, domestic observation. Straightforward, matter-of-fact. A hint of warmth underneath—even small dad-isms are worth mentioning.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと卒業式の壇上に立つ準備したよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I practiced standing on the stage together—for the graduation ceremony.
lines.style: Soft pride in his voice. Gentle awareness of the moment's importance. Slow, careful pace. Quiet closeness with his father in this memory.
